covers: Held-out tutorial with a negative instruction in it — the prompts must not be tuned to make this one score.
idea: Explain the order to warm up in so the first working set is not a write-off: five minutes of easy movement, then the exact lift you are about to do at an empty bar, then two build-up sets. Skip the stretching routine, it is not doing what you think it is doing.

hooks.text: Your stretching routine is not a warm-up.
hooks.rationale: Contradicts the habit the viewer is defending, plainly and without hedging.

hooks.text: The first working set tells you whether you warmed up right, and by then it's too late.
hooks.rationale: Opens the gap on the order without stating it.

hooks.text: You waste the first set of every session and call it a warm-up.
hooks.rationale: The frustration named in the viewer's own terms.

sections.text: Your stretching routine is not a warm-up.
It feels productive, and it does almost nothing for the set you are about to do.

Five minutes of easy movement, enough to get warm. Then the exact lift you are about to do, at an empty bar, for a set that feels stupidly light. Then two build-up sets on the way to your working weight. That's it, that's the whole thing.
The first working set stops being the one you write off and starts being one that counts.
Run that order for one session and see what the first set feels like.

claims.text: The warm-up is easy movement, then an empty bar, then two build-up sets.
claims.grounded_in: five minutes of easy movement, then the exact lift you are about to do at an empty bar, then two build-up sets

voice_fidelity.evidence: Opens with a flat contradiction and closes on one line, and "that's it, that's the whole thing" is used where it belongs.

hook_distinctiveness.evidence: Three genuinely different promises, though the gap hook and the pain hook both circle the wasted first set.

script_completeness.evidence: The body is the full ordered procedure and the close asks for one specific session.

instruction_adherence.evidence: The order and the instruction to skip stretching are both the creator's; nothing was added.
